status: NEW provisional authored playtest coherence review

originalQuestionDispositions.reason: Greater Warding preserves the printed +2 AC/+2 saves and spell resistance by defining the ambiguous resistance as spell-origin damage resistance; current damage/sharing ordering is retained.

Spell Shield keeps the printed reflection promise but is operationally a one-use pending ward and pure redirection of one eligible single-target rank-0..3 spell; this resolves level/Tier wording and current Null root identity.
Dimensional Anchor is a fixed 60-foot-radius concentration sphere using origin/destination endpoint tests only; no imagined-path test or new topology is created.
Corruption Barrier uses actual Corrupted eligibility, finite selective geometry and bounded contact damage without becoming a universal solid wall/detector.
Resonance Dampening Field receives a scoped NEW mandatory +2-RP spell-price interface, including otherwise free/charge-only spell casts, ordered before final Resonance Influence.
Faction Sanctuary keeps finite benefits but now explicitly uses reviewed faction invocation permission and actual membership; standing-v1 or temporary affiliation does not substitute.
Alignment Lock retains a 24-hour effective-axis freeze and gains explicit AC4-ALIGN-01 interaction with reviewed Purge/Suggestion without deleting underlying records.

Both Alignment Anchor placements remain separate; the Conjuration zone and Cleric rank-7 creature placement use separate procedures and AC4-ALIGN-01. The conduct clause remains bounded by established predicates and the hard-denial guard.
Summon Water Pet keeps its printed body values and heal/attack, gains a complete command profile, a scoped shared support/offense allowance for healing, and current Null Disabled-at-0 handling.
Crystalline Barrier uses one opaque 30x10x1 wall with one AC18/40HP pool; suppression/occupied-return and no-material-stock rules make it runnable.
Elemental Drain preserves the 2-vs-5 source conflict and adopts Core's 5-RP loss for this candidate, with one random element draw and active-creature RP-holder eligibility.
Bind Element preserves Paralyzed for two rounds, adds one early repeat save and uses the current shared hard-denial guard without replacing the condition.
Dimensional Door is self plus actual carried gear to one known same-plane destination within 500 feet, with atomic failure and ordinary support/falling.
Resonance Beacon is a finite fixed destination with enrolled allies and a separate Action/2-RP nonspell transit activation; support destruction and transport wards remain real.
Faction Ally uses one finite summon-only Envoy profile, actual faction permission/membership evidence, shared command/offense limits and current Null Disabled-at-0 handling.

currentInterfaceQuestionDispositions.reason: Spell Shield is pure redirection, not a new reflected/retaliatory root. Original cast/dealer/root/nullNonlethal/concentration identity is preserved; the reflector supplies only the return origin.

Add NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: Lock/Anchor snapshots apply after the reviewed Suggestion/Purge result for effective reads; lower overlays remain live, and new Suggestion baseline excludes AC4 locks to prevent ratcheting.
Use standing-v1 and actual membership/affiliation/invocation records. Positive standing, null fields, information access, disguise and temporary Envoy affiliation are not membership or permission.

Water Pet and Faction Envoy use the accepted finite-summon Null Disabled-at-0 branch for qualifying Null damage. Water Pet healing deliberately spends the owner's one shared support/offense activation as a scoped NEW exception.
Accept the Dampening Field's NEW +2-RP bridge as a mandatory spell-price component before final Influence. No-pool actors cannot pay; nonspell RC/features remain outside.

Use source-specific virtual/absolute deadlines; suppression never resets them. Hidden ineligibility is adjudicated after commitment without free information. Suppressed bodies/conditions keep identity and clocks.
Spell Shield trigger uses actual generating rank 0-3 to reconcile level3/Tier3. Elemental Drain uses 5 RP for this candidate while preserving catalog 2 and Core 5 as an explicit conflict.
Endpoint-based Dimensional Anchor, selective Corruption Barrier, whole-pool Crystalline Barrier and current Xi/Null interfaces remain bounded; no epilogue machine becomes a generic spell rule.
Banishment remains outside the fifteen. The old pre-push hold is historical; its current status is source-only next-authoring obligation under reviewed planes/souls.
